scope: Four new precise searches plus reading newly located bodies for two remaining actual-date holds. No application, source binding, identity, private data or deployment change.

sources.title: AtHeart revisits Roo'Ra's 30-year-old summer hit '3!4!'
sources.finding: The release/showcase report contains member interview comments about the remake. Its body gives no Aurora second-hiatus start date or start month, and does not directly state when her absence took effect.
sources.notAdoptedBecause: A group photo, the members quoted, or the publication date cannot establish the actual start of a hiatus.

sources.title: UDTT Members Profile
sources.finding: The Lu Yuting subsection explicitly calls April 29, 2025 a public reveal as a new member. It does not state that joining took effect that day, or that she had joined since a specified month.
sources.shortRelevantQuote: She was revealed as a new member on April 29, 2025.
sources.notAdoptedBecause: Revealed is not an actual joining-date statement. This page is not used to merge any stable member identities or to infer a temporary/permanent contract.

sources.finding: The August 18 hiatus sentence is backed by the already-known Soompi announcement report. The page helped locate the separate Korea Herald release report, but does not supply an independent actual-date source.
sources.sourceIndependence: Do not count the Wikipedia sentence, announcement aggregators or repeated Soompi text as additional independent confirmation.

failedOrNonEvidentialRoutes.result: Existing announcement story resurfaced in search results; not treated as new evidence or re-read as a new source.

outcomes.missing: A direct statement that the second hiatus actually started on a date, or had already started since an explicitly identified month. The existing August 18 announcement date remains separate.
outcomes.nextEvidenceRoute: A retrospective media report, attributable agency statement or dated first-person statement explicitly anchoring the actual start; an official-only publication is not required.

outcomes.missing: A direct retrospective joining-date or joined-since-month statement. Public reveal, debut, performance appearance, interview publication and recording participation do not establish the joining date or contract status.
outcomes.nextEvidenceRoute: A dated member/agency statement or independently attributable report that explicitly says when the joining took effect; preserve empty canonical memberIds and the unresolved contract scope.

humanHelpAssessment: No need to interrupt the user for a guess or a repeated announcement link. If the user already possesses a contemporaneous agency/member post or recording explicitly stating an effective date/month, it could resolve the gap; otherwise retain both holds and continue other evidence routes.
coverageLimit: A bounded four-query pass, not an exhaustive search of every language, platform or archive. No actual dates were promoted.
